topic: Understanding the DP-3T Protocol for Privacy-Preserving Contact Tracing
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Information Security background)

sections.title: The Problem: Proximity without Exposure
lecture_lines: Digital contact tracing tracks exposure safely.
We need to protect identity and location.
Alice and Bob meet without revealing identity.
animations: Show two [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] devices at a distance in #FFFFFF color.
Display a proximity radius symbol in #FFFF00 color.
Indicate the failure to link [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/person.svg] identity to contact.

sections.title: The Foundation: Pseudo-Random IDs
lecture_lines: IDs are derived from daily keys.
animations: Show a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] ID block rotating and changing color to #00FF00.
Draw a key generating ID path in #00FFFF color.
Repeat animation with new ID in #FF00FF color using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartwatch.svg].

sections.title: The Mechanism: Bluetooth Handshakes
lecture_lines: Phones exchange Ephemeral IDs via Bluetooth.
Each phone stores a local Seen List.
No personal data is ever recorded.
animations: Two devices [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg] connect with a beam in #FFFFFF.
Show a local 'Seen List' growing in #00FF00.

sections.title: Infection: The Disclosure Process
lecture_lines: Positive users upload Daily Keys anonymously.
Keys are published to a public board.
Other phones download this keys list.
animations: Anonymized user key moves to central [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/server.svg] in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Matching: Local Verification
lecture_lines: Phones regenerate IDs from downloaded keys.
Privacy remains preserved throughout the process.
animations: Phone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg] locally generates IDs from keys in #00FF00.
Highlight a successful matching ID in #FF0000.
Show a final privacy status icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg] in #00FFFF.
